example.title: C.J.'s apartments: Tudor-trimmed block over brick garages
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A mid-1970s three-storey apartment block: green-grey siding with brown mock-Tudor half-timber trim on two continuous balconies, a red-brick ground floor with two carriage-style garage doors, a shallow shingle roof. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
